content:
ana_infra: heads-up — eu-west had a weird failure during the nightly keystore rotation. a chunk of GPU warm pools in eu-west-1 failed to attach keys and stayed in provisioning.
mike_sre: seen it, getting alerts about node boot timeout + keystore decryption errors. any correlation id or logs?
ana_infra: pasted snippet from node-agent:
```
2025-06-12T03:02:11Z ERROR keystore: decrypt failed: KMS: AccessDenied
node=eu-west-1-pool-7 instance=i-0b12b3cd
2025-06-12T03:02:12Z WARN provisioner: leaving warm pool due to keystore timeout
```
ana_infra: looks like an IAM condition on the kms key got tightened overnight from compliance change. it rejects cross-account calls for the provisioning role.
devon_sec: correct — policy change deployed in policy-engine at 02:45 UTC. it added "aws:SourceVpc" condition to the CMK grant for eu keys. that blocks the cross-account assume role we use for ephemeral keystore proxies.
jules_eng: so nodes can't decrypt bootstrap secrets -> they fail health checks -> warmpool drains -> downstream capacity shortage. are we seeing falls in available GPUs for customer routed traffic?
mike_sre: yes — autoscaler swung harder. a handful of Dedicated pools in eu-west degraded latency for heavy batching jobs. fallback routing kicked in to other regions, raising egress and cross-region cost.
ana_infra: roll-forward options: 1) revert policy-engine change (compliance risk), 2) patch provisioning role to be in-source-vpc (needs rollout to infra account), 3) add short-term policy exception for provisioning service only.
devon_sec: recommend option 3 for now — create temporary CMK grant scoped to the provisioning role with a 6-hour expire. will audit log the exception.
ops-bot: deploy-notice: created temporary CMK grant for keystore-proxy-role in eu-west-1 (grant id: g-3f2c). TTL: 6h. by @devon_sec
jules_eng: will monitor warm pools — spinning some small canary capacity to validate decrypt succeeds.
ana_infra: quick ask: can you add an eval to Redwood Optimize so it detects keystore-access regressions? catches this earlier.
mike_sre: good idea — file created in infra/evals tracker. i'll attach a replay of the failing provisioning attempts.
devon_sec: will follow up with infra ownership to propose a safer policy change that allows provisioning proxies but keeps SourceVpc constraint for other roles.
ana_infra: thanks. keeping this thread as the live comms for the incident. tagging infra oncall if it escalates @mike_sre :thumbsup:
